request: Confirm the batch uses latest released tools and that install protocols match official recommendations with no gaps.

corpus.verified: 34 of 34 checks pass: 17 tools, release artifact and official install guide each.

version_currency.dossiers: Separately, all 42 dossiers still record commits inspected 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-01 and are stale relative to the batch; see treatment-version-currency-20260822.json.

verified_against_official_guide.rtk: init --global --auto-patch for Claude and --codex for Codex both match README lines 115-118 and 339.
verified_against_official_guide.graphify: `graphify codex install --project` matches README line 194; multi_agent=true covers the Codex requirement at line 237; warmup `graphify update --force` matches line 582.
verified_against_official_guide.lean-ctx: `init --agent codex` matches README line 531-534, and the lane also runs the guide's `doctor` confirmation step.
verified_against_official_guide.token-savior: `ts init --agent codex --global --yes` matches README line 89, and the profile sets TS_BASH_COMPACT=1 and TS_BASH_REWRITE=1, which README lines 80-87 require because compaction is opt-in.
verified_against_official_guide.caveman: native per-agent install path matches INSTALL.md lines 25-26.

blocking_finding.finding: `ts init --agent codex` installs tool-capture-codex.json, memory-codex.json and discipline-guard-codex.json. bash-rewriter-config.json is Claude-only in this version (cli_init/agent_paths.py _HOOK_CONFIG_FILES). Bash compaction and PreToolUse rewriting are therefore not part of the official Codex integration at 4.21.0.
blocking_finding.why_it_matters: Those are the surfaces most directly tied to token reduction. A Codex treatment run would exercise capture, memory and discipline-guard only, so a null or small result would say nothing about the compaction the tool is known for.
blocking_finding.instrumentation_defect: probe_token_savior_codex_hooks.py invokes hooks/bash_rewriter_hook.py directly rather than through what ts init wires, so it proves the binary can rewrite, not that the Codex install enables it. Its PostToolUse assertion also expects a `[token-savior:compact]` marker and additionalContext shape that no longer appear anywhere in the 4.21.0 source.
options: Run token-savior on Codex as a capture/memory treatment and say so explicitly.
Move token-savior to the Claude Code lane, where the vendor ships the full hook set.
Ask the author whether Codex bash-rewriter support is planned before spending on it.
